hooks.name: devlog
hooks.description: Append a one-line entry to DEVLOG.md after each spec task

action.prompt: A spec task just completed. Append exactly one line to DEVLOG.md at the repo root in the form: YYYY-MM-DD | <spec> | <task id> | <one-sentence summary> | <files changed>. Keep the whole line under 30 words. If DEVLOG.md does not exist, create it first with the single header line "# Devlog". Do nothing else.
